intro_html: Warm, spiced shawarma flavor over rice with a cool yogurt drizzle, all made at home for cheap. Each serving delivers 48 grams of protein for about $4.15 (at everyday cost) and the batch makes 14 bowls. That is a spice-shop of flavor for less than the price of a single street-cart wrap.
cost_closing_html: About $4.15 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Every one of the 14 bowls carries 48 grams of protein at 595 calories, so this spiced favorite fuels you as well as it tastes.
upsell_html: Street-cart flavor from your own kitchen, portioned and ready. Adventure eating on a budget. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Build the shawarma spice from cumin, paprika, and garlic powder in your rack instead of paying up for a pre-mixed shawarma blend.
A tub of plain greek yogurt gives you the classic cool sauce and adds protein for pennies per serving.
One can of diced tomatoes brings the moisture and tang, so no need for expensive jarred sauces here.
make_it: Brown 5.4 pounds of 93/7 ground beef with the chopped onion, cumin, paprika, garlic, and garlic powder, then drain.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and beef broth and simmer until saucy.
Cook the rice separately so it stays light and fluffy.
Whisk the greek yogurt with a little garlic for a quick cooling sauce.
Spoon the shawarma beef over rice and finish with the yogurt drizzle.
